40023266.author: पदार्थः
40023266.content: एतावत् this much, एतत् this, आख्यानं narrative, सोत्तरं with the Uttara Kanda, ब्रह्मपूजितम् revered by Brahma, रामायणम् Ramayana, इति thus, ख्यातं known, मुख्यं principal, वाल्मीकीना by Valmiki, कृतम् composed.

40023266.author: Translation
40023266.content: This is the complete narrative, including the Uttara Kanda, revered by Brahma, known as the Ramayana, and composed as the foremost work by Valmiki.

40023267.author: पदार्थः
40023267.content: ततः thereafter, प्रतिष्ठितः established, विष्णुः Vishnu, स्वर्गलोके in the heavenly realm, यथा as, पुरम् before, येन by whom, व्याप्तम् pervaded, इदं this, सर्वं all, त्रैलोक्यं three worlds, सचराचरम् with moving and non-moving beings.

40023267.author: Translation
40023267.content: Thereafter, Vishnu, by whom all these three worlds, with their moving and non-moving beings, are pervaded, resided in the heavenly realm as before.

40023268.author: पदार्थः
40023268.content: ततः then, देवाः gods, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, सिद्धाः Siddhas, च and, परमर्षयः great sages, नित्यं always, शृण्वन्ति listen, सन्तुष्टाः delighted, दिव्यं divine, रामायणं Ramayana, दिवि in heaven.

40023268.author: Translation
40023268.content: Then, the gods, along with the Gandharvas, Siddhas, and great sages, always listen to the divine Ramayana in heaven with great delight.

40023269.author: पदार्थः
40023269.content: इदम् this, आख्यानम् narrative, आयुष्यम् promoting longevity, सौभाग्यम् good fortune, पापनाशनम् destroyer of sins, रामायणम् Ramayana, वेदसमम् equal to the Vedas, श्राद्धेषु in ancestral rites, श्रावयेत् should cause to be heard, बुधः a wise person.

40023269.author: Translation
40023269.content: A wise person should recite this narrative, the Ramayana, which promotes longevity, brings good fortune, destroys sins, and is equal to the Vedas, especially during ancestral rites.

40023270.author: पदार्थः
40023270.content: अपुत्रः one without a son, लभते obtains, पुत्रम् a son, अधनः one without wealth, लभते obtains, धनम् wealth, सर्वपापैः from all sins, प्रमुच्येत is freed, पदम् a word, अपि even, अस्य of this, यः who, पठेत् reads.

40023270.author: Translation
40023270.content: One who reads even a single word of this (Ramayana) obtains a son if childless, wealth if poor, and is freed from all sins.

40023271.author: पदार्थः
40023271.content: पापानि sins, अपि even, च and, यः who, कुर्यात् commits, अहन्यहनि day after day, मानवः a human being, पठति reads, एकम् one, अपि even, श्लोकम् verse, पापात् from sin, सः he, परिमुच्यते is completely freed.

40023271.author: Translation
40023271.content: Even a human being who commits sins daily, if he recites even one verse (from the Ramayana), is completely freed from those sins.

40023272.author: पदार्थः
40023272.content: वाचकाय to the reciter, च and, दातव्यम् should be given, वस्त्रम् clothes, धेनुम् a cow, हिरण्यकम् gold, वाचके when the reciter, परितुष्टे is completely pleased, तु indeed, तुष्टाः pleased, स्युः become, सर्वदेवताः all deities.

40023272.author: Translation
40023272.content: Clothes, a cow, and gold should be given to the reciter, for when the reciter is completely pleased, all deities become pleased.

40023273.author: पदार्थः
40023273.content: एतत् this, आख्यानम् narrative, आयुष्यम् promoting longevity, पठन् reading, रामायणम् Ramayana, नरः a person, सपुत्रपौत्रः with sons and grandsons, लोके in the world, अस्मिन् this, प्रेत्य after death, च and, इह here, महीयते is honored.

40023273.author: Translation
40023273.content: A person who recites this life-giving narrative, the Ramayana, is honored in this world with sons and grandsons, and also after death.

40023274.author: पदार्थः
40023274.content: अयोध्या Ayodhya, अपि even, पुरी city, रम्या beautiful, शून्या empty, वर्षगणान् for many years, बहून् many, ऋषभम् Rishabha, प्राप्य having obtained, राजानम् as king, निवासम् habitation, उपयास्यति will attain.

40023274.author: Translation
40023274.content: The beautiful city of Ayodhya, which has been deserted for many years, will once again become inhabited when King Rishabha takes the throne.

40023275.author: पदार्थः
40023275.content: एतत् this, आख्यानम् narrative, आयुष्यम् life-giving, सभविष्यम् with the future (events), सहउत्तरम् with the Uttara Kanda, कृतवान् composed, प्रचेतसः of Prachetas, पुत्रः son, तत् that, ब्रह्मा Brahma, अपि even, अन्वमन्यत approved.

40023275.author: Translation
40023275.content: The son of Prachetas (Valmiki) composed this life-giving narrative, including its future events and the Uttara Kanda, and even Brahma himself approved of it.

40023276.author: पदार्थः
40023276.content: अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य of a thousand Ashwamedha sacrifices, वाजपेयायुतस्य of ten thousand Vajapeya sacrifices, च and, लभते obtains, श्रावणात् from listening, एव merely, सर्गस्य of a canto, एकस्य of one, मानवः a person.

40023276.author: Translation
40023276.content: A person who merely listens to a single canto of this epic obtains the merit of performing a thousand Ashwamedha sacrifices and ten thousand Vajapeya sacrifices.

40023277.author: पदार्थः
40023277.content: प्रयागादीनि Prayaga and others, तीर्थानि holy places, गङ्गाद्याः Ganga and others, सरितः rivers, तथा similarly, नैमिशादीनि Naimisha and others, अरण्यानि forests, कुरुक्षेत्रादीनि Kurukshetra and others, अपि also, गतानि visited, तेन by him, लोके in this world, अस्मिन् this, येन by whom, रामायणम् Ramayana, श्रुतम् heard.

40023277.author: Translation
40023277.content: In this world, whoever has listened to the Ramayana is considered to have visited holy places like Prayaga, rivers like Ganga, forests like Naimisha, and regions like Kurukshetra.

40023278.author: पदार्थः
40023278.content: हेमभारम् a load of gold, कुरुक्षेत्रे in Kurukshetra, ग्रस्ते when eclipsed, भानौ the sun, प्रयच्छति gives, यः who, च and, रामायणम् Ramayana, लोके in the world, शृणोति listens, सदृशौ equal, उभौ both.

40023278.author: Translation
40023278.content: One who donates a load of gold in Kurukshetra during a solar eclipse and one who listens to the Ramayana in this world are both considered equal in merit.

40023279.author: पदार्थः
40023279.content: सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमायुक्तः endowed with complete faith, शृणुते listens, राघवीं relating to Raghava (Rama), कथाम् story, सर्वपापात् from all sins, प्रमुच्येत is liberated, विष्णुलोकं to the world of Vishnu, स he, गच्छति goes.

40023279.author: Translation
40023279.content: One who listens to the story of Rama with complete faith is liberated from all sins and attains the abode of Vishnu.

40023280.author: पदार्थः
40023280.content: आदिकाव्यम् the first epic poem, इदं this, तु indeed, आर्षं composed by a Rishi, पुरा formerly, वाल्मीकिना by Valmiki, कृतम् composed, यः who, शृणोति listens, सदा always, भक्त्या with devotion, स he, गच्छेत् would attain, वैष्णवीं Vishnu-like, तनुम् body.

40023280.author: Translation
40023280.content: This ancient epic, composed by Valmiki, is the first poem, and whoever always listens to it with devotion will attain a divine form akin to Vishnu.

40023281.author: पदार्थः
40023281.content: पुत्रदाराः sons and wives, च and, वर्धन्ते increase, सम्पदः wealth, सन्ततिः progeny, तथा and, सत्यम् truth, एतत् this, विदित्वा having known, तु indeed, श्रोतव्यं should be heard, नियतात्मभिः by those with controlled minds.

40023281.author: Translation
40023281.content: Sons, wives, wealth, and progeny all increase, and knowing this truth, those with self-controlled minds should indeed listen to it.

40023282.author: पदार्थः
40023282.content: गायत्र्याः of Gayatri, च and, स्वरूपं the very form, तत् that, रामायणम् Ramayana, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.

40023282.author: Translation
40023282.content: That Ramayana is indeed the very essence of the Gayatri Mantra and is unsurpassed.

40023283.author: पदार्थः
40023283.content: अपुत्रः one without a son, लभते obtains, पुत्रम् a son, अधनः one without wealth, लभते obtains, धनम् wealth, सर्वपापैः from all sins, प्रमुच्येत is liberated, पदम् a word/verse, अपि even, अस्य of this, यः who, पठेत् reads.

40023283.author: Translation
40023283.content: One without a son obtains a son, one without wealth obtains wealth, and whoever reads even a single verse of this (Ramayana) is liberated from all sins.

40023284.author: पदार्थः
40023284.content: यः who, पठेत् reads, शृणुयात् listens, नित्यम् daily, चरितम् the story, राघवस्य of Raghava, ह indeed, भक्त्या with devotion, निष्कल्मषः free from sin, भूत्वा having become, दीर्घम् long, आयुः life, अवाप्नुयात् attains.

40023284.author: Translation
40023284.content: One who daily reads or listens to the story of Raghava with devotion, becoming free from sin, attains a long life.

40023285.author: पदार्थः
40023285.content: चिन्तयेत् should meditate upon, राघवम् Raghava, नित्यम् daily, श्रेयः welfare, प्राप्तुम् to obtain, यः who, इच्छति desires, श्रावयेत् should narrate, इदम् this, आख्यानम् narrative, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to Brahmins, दिने दिने daily.

40023285.author: Translation
40023285.content: One who desires to attain ultimate welfare should daily meditate upon Raghava and should narrate this story to Brahmins day by day.

40023286.author: पदार्थः
40023286.content: यः who, तु indeed, इदम् this, रघुनाथस्य of Raghunatha, चरितम् story, सकलम् entire, पठेत् reads, सः he, असुक्षये at the end of life, विष्णुलोकम् to the world of Vishnu, गच्छति goes, एव certainly, न no, संशयः doubt.

40023286.author: Translation
40023286.content: One who reads this entire story of Raghunatha certainly goes to the world of Vishnu at the end of life; there is no doubt about it.

40023287.author: पदार्थः
40023287.content: पिता father, पितामहः grandfather, तस्य his, तथैव similarly, प्रपितामहः great-grandfather, तत्पिता his father (great-great-grandfather), तत्पिता his father (great-great-great-grandfather), च and, एव certainly, विष्णुम् to Vishnu, यान्ति go, न no, संशयः doubt.

40023287.author: Translation
40023287.content: His father, grandfather, and similarly his great-grandfather, great-great-grandfather, and great-great-great-grandfather all certainly go to Vishnu; there is no doubt about it.

40023288.author: पदार्थः
40023288.content: चतुर्वर्गप्रदम् bestower of the four aims of life, नित्यम् always, चरितम् the story, राघवस्य of Raghava, तु indeed, तस्मात् therefore, यत्नवता by one who is diligent, नित्यम् always, श्रोतव्यम् should be heard, परमम् supreme, सदा always.

40023288.author: Translation
40023288.content: The story of Raghava is always the bestower of the four aims of life; therefore, it should always be heard with supreme diligence.

40023289.author: पदार्थः
40023289.content: शृण्वन् one who listens, रामायणम् Ramayana, भक्त्या with devotion, यः who, पादम् a quarter (of a verse), पदम् a word, एव even, वा or, सः he, याति attains, ब्रह्मणः of Brahma, स्थानम् the abode, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, पूज्यते is worshipped, सदा always.

40023289.author: Translation
40023289.content: Whoever listens to even a quarter of a verse or a single word of the Ramayana with devotion attains the abode of Brahma and is always worshipped by Brahma himself.

40023290.author: पदार्थः
40023290.content: एवम् thus, एतत् this, पुरावृत्तम् ancient, आख्यानम् narrative, भद्रम् welfare, अस्तु let there be, वः to you, प्रव्याहरत proclaim, विस्रब्धम् confidently, बलम् the strength, विष्णोः of Vishnu, प्रवर्धताम् let it increase.

40023290.author: Translation
40023290.content: Thus is this ancient narrative; may welfare be to you; proclaim it confidently, and may the strength of Vishnu increase. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे श्रीमद्वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये चतुर्विंशत्सहस्रिकायां संहितायां श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकादशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 111 ।। Thus ends the hundred and eleventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki. ।। इत्युत्तरकाण्डः समाप्तः ।। Thus the Uttara Kanda is concluded. ।। इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्रामायणं सम्पूर्णम् ।। Thus the glorious Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki, is complete. ।। श्रीसीतारामचन्द्रार्पणमस्तु ।। May this work be an offering unto the glorious Sita and Ramachandra.
